title: Delegation v1
description: A sub-agent request. Same field names as today's walter_run so the tool keeps its name and shape. Status: DRAFT (E0), implemented at E5. Children never exceed the parent's rights minus the NEVER list.

context.description: Caller-provided facts; the child's starting dossier itself is a ChildContextSpec served by walter-context

toolsets.description: shell = the engine's sandboxed shell (never the removed walter_run terminal); file = the child's own workspace

output_contract.description: JSON schema the child's answer must satisfy

session_id.description: Stable engine session id: <interface>/<account or caller>/<conversation>. Fixed by intake, never by the model.

depth.description: 0 = the turn itself; a request at the maximum depth is refused

reuse_plan.description: True when the delegated goal is the owner's message: the run's ContextPlan is reused

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key: same key = same effect, never applied twice
